topic: Meditation cures clinical depression in adults with major depressive disorder

referenced_sources.title: Effects of an 8-Week Mindfulness Program on Self-Reported Stress in Healthy College Students
referenced_sources.abstract: This study examined self-reported stress levels in 24 healthy undergraduate students before and after an 8-week mindfulness meditation program. Participants reported modest reductions in self-perceived stress via questionnaire. No participants had a diagnosed mental health condition. Depression, clinical outcomes, and long-term effects were not measured.

referenced_sources.title: Environmental Enrichment Reduces Anxiety-Like Behavior and Increases Hippocampal Neurogenesis in Mice
referenced_sources.abstract: We investigated the effects of environmental enrichment on anxiety-like behavior and hippocampal neurogenesis in laboratory mice. Enriched mice showed reduced anxiety-like behavior in maze tests and increased neurogenesis markers compared to controls. This is a preclinical animal model study; no human subjects were involved.
